policy: exact belief-space planner (finite-horizon dynamic program, imported from the committed belief planner) over a belief that reads every relation the briefing carries about the target
grading: correct = the search ended on a confirming sighting and the place it reported is the hidden truth; wrong = it reported somewhere else

plain.description: the plain filter's belief, one distribution updated claim by claim; reproduces the committed sweep

matched_informed.description: every reading on, split prior taken from the generator transport rate

matched_carts_hidden.description: every reading on except that a cart parked in a room is not part of what an inspection of that room reveals, which is what the executor does; split prior 0.5

matched_informed_carts_hidden.description: as matched_carts_hidden, split prior taken from the generator transport rate
